subject: Folder access and dates
text:
Hi,

As a family friend and coworker, I know you are busy. The shared folder is acting odd. I cannot open the latest task list. It says access denied. I asked the portal team. They are slow today.

I do not want to miss a deadline. Are we still targeting Thursday? Or did the client shift to Monday?

I have a draft ready. I just need final comments. If you send them by noon, I can finish early. If not, I will update you later.

Please also check if my access was revoked. A quick ping would help.

Thanks again. I appreciate it. Have a good day.
